name: pg_privileges_alter_group_drop
subject: Fix an ALTER GROUP ... DROP USER error message.
goal:
ALTER GROUP ... DROP USER reports a misleading authorization detail: it names the wrong option required to modify role membership, unlike the corresponding ADD USER path.

As a role without authority to administer a target role, attempt both ALTER GROUP ... ADD USER and DROP USER. Both must fail with `permission denied to alter role` and the detail `Only roles with the %s option on role "%s" may add or drop members.`, filled with the correct option and role. Successful membership changes and unrelated role errors must be unchanged.
contract: Only roles with the %s option on role \"%s\" may add or drop members.
